{{TAG:0003:0025:}}The lady who works at this place is
pretty cool, so I like talking to her!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La señora que trabaja aquí es
majísima. ¡Me encanta charlar
con ella, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La nana qui tient cette boutique est
bien cool, elle a toujours des trucs
marrants à raconter,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

una certa personalità. Chiacchierare

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Kinda gloomy weather, right? I'm
thinking maybe some new clothes
will cheer me up! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Menudo tiempo más chungo, ¿no?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡A lo mejor si me compro algún
trapito, me animo a tope!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ce temps pourri m'déprime...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Alors
j'essaie d'compenser en achetant
d'la sape,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Questo tempo è un po' triste, eh?
Un vestito nuovo potrebbe tirarmi
su! Forse... {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ganz schön finster und unappetitlich
da draußen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}was? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Neue Klamotten
wären jetzt genau das Richtige!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Hava biraz kasvetli, değil mi?
Belki yeni bir şeyler giyersem
benim de havam değişir! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'm looking for a super-strong
umbrella that will hold up to the
worst rains ever{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}I can't find one like that that's also
pretty, though. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Necesito un paraguas muy fuerte,
que aguante hasta un vendaval{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}¡Lo difícil es que también sea mono!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'cherche un parapluie ultra costaud
qui tiendrait l'choc même par un
temps déchaîné comme aujourd'hui.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Y'en a quelques-uns qui semblent
faire l'affaire, mais qu'est-ce qu'y
sont moches,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sto cercando un ombrello
capace di resistere alla pioggia
battente più ostinata{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Però vorrei che fosse anche stiloso.
Ogni tanto anche l'occhio vuole
la sua parte, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich bin auf der Suche nach 'nem
robusten Regenschirm,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} der auch
'nen Monsun überleben würde{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Kann nur keinen finden, der robust
UND schön ist, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En beter sağanağa bile kafa tutacak
taş gibi sağlam bir şemsiye arıyorum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Ama hem öyle sağlam hem de şık
olanını bulmak zor. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yesterday I read this article called
"Snowy Mountain {{TAG:0004:0001:}}."{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Apparently some colors are easier
to spot in the snow than others.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}I gotta get the right clothes in case
I'm ever stuck in an avalanche!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ayer antes de la siesta estuve
viendo un documental sobre
el invierno y las montañas y tal.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Al parecer, hay colores que se
distinguen mejor en la nieve.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Por eso voy a aprovisionarme,
¡no vaya a ser que haya una
avalancha y no me encuentren!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hier, j'lisais l'édition {{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0004:0001:}}
de ce canard, là, Il a neigé sur ma
montagne...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Apparemment, dans la neige, t'as
des couleurs qui s'voient mieux que
d'autres !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Genre le blanc, t'oublies.
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Du coup, chuis venue pécho des
fringues bien bariolées, des fois que
j'sois prise dans une avalanche !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ieri ho letto un articolo
intitolato: "Sulla neve {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0004:0001:}}".{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Pare che, in mezzo alla neve, certi
colori si notino più di altri.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Devo scegliere i vestiti giusti allora!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Potrei sempre essere investita
da una valanga, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Erst gestern hab ich die
{{TAG:0004:0001:}}ausgabe von
„Schneegestöber“ gelesen.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Anscheinend sind wohl manche
Farben einfacher im Schnee zu
sehen als andere. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Toll, nicht?
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ich muss mir jetzt SOFORT ein
Schneelawinen-Notfall-Outfit
zulegen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Man kann nie wissen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dün "Karlı Dağ {{TAG:0004:0001:}}" diye bir
yazı okudum.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Meğer bazı renkler
karda daha kolay fark ediliyormuş.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}
Bir gün çığ altında kalırsam diye
doğru renkleri giymem lazım! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I want to get a picture of me
holding a classy umbrella with the
cherry blossoms blowing around me.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}If I don't hurry up and get an
umbrella, the blossoms will all be on
the ground! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¿No te encantan las fotos de chicas
con sombrillas elegantes al lado
de cerezos en flor?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Yo quiero tener una así, pero como
siempre me levanto a las mil, ¡nunca
hay suficiente luz para hacerla!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}J'en ai ras l'bol d'retrouver ces
satanés pétales dans ma tignasse et
dans mes godasses, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Y m'faut un parapluie, et vite !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
Enfin...{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} un parapétale, plutôt !

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Voglio farmi scattare una foto
con un ombrello stiloso... sotto
una pioggia di petali di ciliegio.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Se non mi sbrigo a comprarne uno,

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich will dieses Jahr unbedingt ein
Foto von mir mit Sonnenschirm
unter den Kirschbäumen.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Wenn ich jetzt nicht 'nen Zahn
